candidates_examined.reason: CHECKSUM_PARTIAL sink writes __sum16 at to+csstart+skb->csum_offset with no re-validation of csum_offset against headlen/buffer; only guard is BUG_ON(csstart > headlen). Callers are legacy NIC TX copy loops (8139too, via-rhine, ep93xx, sc92031, ec_bhf, ksz884x) where 'to' is a fixed-size driver TX buffer -> OOB write if csum_offset invalid.
Validates offset = csum_start_offset + csum_offset; requires offset + sizeof(__sum16) <= hdlen before trim.
WARN_ON_ONCE(offset >= headlen) and WARN_ON_ONCE(offset + 2 > headlen) with skb_ensure_writable.
Only switches on csum_offset equality for feature decision; falls through to skb_checksum_help.
Canonical validated setter; rejects csum_start > U16_MAX or csum_end > headlen.
Value only used as a min_len hint for BPF helper clamping, not as a memory offset dereference.
csum_start >= hdrlen checked; result stored into GUE option header bytes, hardware re-checks.
Adjusts csum_start by +/- HSR_HLEN symmetric with skb head changes; no unvalidated dereference.
Copies headers via skb_copy_bits with return check before using start + csum_offset offset on the freshly copied linear nskb; offset bounded by copied region.
Bounds-checked against VMXNET3_MAX_CSUM_OFFSET and pskb_may_pull(copy_size); value only feeds hardware descriptor.
Producer path uses pskb_may_pull(needed) + skb_partial_csum_set; consumer trusts skb.
Grows hdr_len to cover csum_start+csum_offset+2 and rejects hdr_len > len.
Values only written into hardware descriptor fields, not used as kernel memory offsets.

note: s04 net/xdp/xsk.c has no XDP_TXMD_FLAGS_CHECKSUM/tx_metadata path at all (grep empty), so the seed producer itself is absent from this snapshot; consumers are the exposure surface.
